components/analytics/not-found-tracker.t.name: 404 tracker
components/analytics/not-found-tracker.t.description: Captures a 404_error PostHog event with the landed URL in production, retrying with backoff until the client is loaded.

components/analytics/posthog-provider.ts.name: PostHog provider
components/analytics/posthog-provider.ts.description: Initialises posthog-js in production only, cookieless with memory persistence and recordings, flags, surveys and tours disabled.

components/feedback/client.tsx.name: Page feedback bar
components/feedback/client.tsx.description: Client thumbs up/down form that expands to a text box, posts through a server action and remembers a sent rating per pathname.

components/feedback/limits.ts.name: Feedback message limit
components/feedback/limits.ts.description: Exports the 2000-character message cap shared by the form and the schema, kept apart so the client chunk skips zod.

components/feedback/schema.ts.name: Feedback payload schema
components/feedback/schema.ts.description: Defines the zod contract the feedback server action re-parses: an opinion, a site-relative pathname and a bounded message.
